features.name: any_comment_triple_enumeration
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a triple inline enumeration of the form 'X, Y, and Z' or 'X; Y; and Z'?

h0: any_comment_triple_enumeration has no association with delta.
h1: Rows with any_comment_triple_enumeration = 1 have a higher probability of delta than rows with 0.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change); association only, not causal. The row-level feature is 'any comment has a triple enumeration' because the claim does not specify count or share. Regex is an approximation (false positives/negatives, e.g., Oxford-comma-less lists, longer lists, non-list clauses). Comments are unordered, with no per-comment outcome, so the delta-winning comment cannot be identified; the feature may be driven by comment count/length (no controls added). Raw comment text may contain view-change/delta announcements; this contamination risk is not filtered.
